title: Consensus references: dishes listed by at least two independent food-composition sources
rules: Independent families: usda (SR Legacy, FNDDS survey and Foundation share one lineage, so they count once), cofid (UK CoFID 2021), indb (Indian Nutrient Databank published totals, as built into foods.db: deep-fried dishes whose totals count the whole frying oil are left out).

One reference per family per dish, chosen for the same preparation as the query (homemade over retail where both exist). A ref that names a different preparation is listed under excludedRefs with the reason, never silently dropped.
This file holds only ids, codes and reasons. Every value comes from the source data at build time (scripts/eval/build-sets.ts); nothing is typed by hand or produced by an AI.
point: every family within 15% of the highest kcal value (min >= 0.85 * max); the reference is the mean of the families.
range: families disagree by more than 15% but max <= 1.5 * min; the reference is [min, max] and an estimate inside it scores 0 error.
excluded: families disagree by more than 1.5x; kept in the output with that reason, never scored.
hide: catalog foods whose names match this pattern are hidden from the model's candidates, as if the catalog lacked the dish entirely.
